notes: Eval 2 (intermittent-production-race): WITHOUT-SKILL scored 78% unexpectedly high — assertions include generic debugging steps that any response may partially satisfy. Consider tightening assertions to require specific Heisenbug methodology (operation IDs, no-breakpoints rule, amplification steps).

Eval 1 (silent-failure-angular) shows largest absolute gain (+70%) — skill's Angular NgZone pattern matching and DDx Gate produce highly targeted diagnosis vs without-skill's scatter-shot suggestions.
Eval 4 (ddx-gate-multi-hypothesis) achieves 100% with skill — structured evidence matrix and 3 competing hypotheses are exactly what the assertions check.
Eval 5 (trigger-and-intake) shows 100% vs 25% — the skill's structured 8-question intake is highly differentiating; baseline gives a generic 'tell me more'.
Overall: skill improves pass rate by +50 percentage points on average (94% vs 43%). Strongest gains in intake discipline and DDx Gate methodology.
Recommendation: tighten Eval 2 assertions to require 'non-invasive' keyword or specific operation ID code snippet to better discriminate skill quality.
